card.description: The U.S. Homeland Security secretary will be interviewed by Laura Barrón-López of PBS NewsHour. The conversation starts at 5:15 p.m. Friday.

tweets.text:
#OTD DHS established the first-ever Tribal Homeland Security Advisory Council - a group of Tribal leaders to advise the Secretary on homeland security policies and practices affecting Indian Country and indigenous communities. 

Last year the council focused on cybersecurity, addressing the crisis of Missing or Murdered Indigenous People, and how the Department can improve equity and accessibility to grant funding and DHS resources for Tribal Nations ⬇️ 
https://t.co/i5Os8v7e1d

tweets.text: Kendra B. was in 8th grade on September 11, watching the events that would shape her future. Driven to serve, she joined the Air Force at 17 years old and now proudly wears the @TSA uniform, committed to protecting our nation every day. Thank you, Kendra. #NeverForget https://t.co/7PsCfIF5dK
tweets.text_resolved: Kendra B. was in 8th grade on September 11, watching the events that would shape her future. Driven to serve, she joined the Air Force at 17 years old and now proudly wears the @TSA uniform, committed to protecting our nation every day. Thank you, Kendra. #NeverForget https://t.co/7PsCfIF5dK

media.alt_text: Kendra B. - "Our mission is important to me because I want my daughters to grow up in a world that's safer than it was for me. Safety and security are elemental human rights, so if my contributions can keep future generations safer, it's my duty as an American to do so."

tweets.text: Roxanne J. turned the tragedy of September 11 into a mission of service. Now with @TSA Investigations, she plays a vital role behind the scenes, driving change and upholding our nation’s security with integrity. Thank you, Roxanne, for your unwavering commitment. #NeverForget https://t.co/hAuknVvxUW

tweets.text: Kathleen H.’s connection to September 11 is deeply personal—she was set to fly on United 93. Today, she serves as a @CBP Agriculture Specialist, protecting our nation from threats like pests, drugs, and more. Thank you, Kathleen, for your unwavering dedication. #NeverForget https://t.co/I1dSTCmuc1
